title: Data catalogue for critical infrastructure research
description: A searchable metadata catalogue of data sources, models, simulation platforms and documented case studies for infrastructure research. Relevant resources are distributed across providers, repositories, languages and disciplines. This catalogue brings their descriptions and access links together to support resource discovery, research and innovation. The archive includes the catalogue records and the static dashboard source.
